pd_clippings.notes: BOTH channels: Wiki+Met PD/OA first (keyword stage up to 30 → vision_judge). PASS → scene hero. REJECT / no candidate → Flux fill. Target 20–30 heroes (mid 25, hard cap 30). Never reuse weak PD. Napstorian: 10–15 PD motion; historian: 4–6 soft pans.

cinematic.prompt_suffix: cinematic realism, volumetric light, film still, historically grounded, no modern text artifacts

pd_clippings.notes: Wiki+Met primary (asset_fetcher keyword + curated fetch). vision_judge PASS only; Flux = reject/gap filler. Stamp commercial_ok/source_url/license.

infographic.notes: PIL chapter/mid-beat cards → FFmpeg overlay. Netflix density ~every 60–90s (COMPOSE_INFOGRAPHIC_MAX_CARDS=20, TARGET_INTERVAL_S=75).

premium_overlays_v1.notes: Ken Burns + text plates + map arrows + fog drift + year stamp + progress rail + lower-thirds + quote/letter + History-vs-What-If + cold-open title + pulse/vignette/letterbox. COMPOSE_PREMIUM_OVERLAYS=1. Channel tone: napstorian sharp / napping_historian calm.

toonbee.prompt_suffix: clean flat illustration, bold shapes, limited palette, storybook history panel, not photoreal
